DT-04 at :146 states the rejection itself in strictness terms: '❌ REJECTED asymmetrically: a floor a user can *lower* is not a floor — the first person to lower it is the person about to quote the number commercially, which is exactly who must not. This is loose drafting on one adverb, not a fork that produces two defensible implementations.
